# India Fintech Risk Atlas
> An open research preview of Indian fintech fraud patterns, controls, and operational risks. Not legal advice or an independently certified compliance checklist.

## About
- Source: https://github.com/eyeinthesky6/india-fintech-risk-atlas
- Live Documentation: https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/
- [Structured JSON dataset](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/atlas-records.json): records, claims, sources and graph.
- [Full knowledge pack](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/llms-full.txt): consolidated record text.
- [Local MCP setup](https://github.com/eyeinthesky6/india-fintech-risk-atlas/tree/main/mcp): local stdio only.
- Products currently represented: cards, upi. Coverage is not exhaustive.
- Source-checked records await independent review. Draft records may have blocked primary sources. Regulatory material can include proposals or future obligations. Verify the scope, effective date and primary text before relying on a claim.
- Evidence Layers: Regulatory (RBI/NPCI), Industry practice, Community insight, Research & academic, Atlas guidance

## Canonical Risk Records
- [UPI-OVERVIEW: UPI ecosystem and participant roles](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/upi-ecosystem/): UPI-OVERVIEW — system architecture, participant boundaries, and asymmetric risk telemetry. | Layers: official, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [CARD-OVERVIEW: Card Ecosystem & Clearing Architecture](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/cards/card-ecosystem/): Overview of the 4-party card payment model in India, dual-message clearing flows, CoFT tokenization rails, and interchange risk boundaries. | Layers: official, industry, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-25
- [UPI-001: Unusual outbound payment velocity](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/unusual-outbound-velocity/): UPI-001 — account-level outbound burst and rapid balance-depletion signals. | Layers: official, research, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-002: Potential mule-account funnel](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/mule-account-funnel/): UPI-002 — pass-through layering networks, RBIH MuleHunter.AI / I4C coordination, and relational detection limits. | Layers: official, research, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-003: Account takeover and device-binding risk](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/account-takeover/): UPI-003 — unauthorized account/device compromise, SIM/device binding, and post-change cooling periods. | Layers: official, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-004: Collect-request deception](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/collect-request-deception/): UPI-004 — social engineering around payment direction, P2P collect discontinuation, and P2M pull controls. | Layers: official, industry, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-005: Payment status and order reconciliation](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/payment-status-reconciliation/): UPI-005 — merchant/PA payment status, webhook authenticity, idempotency, and order-fulfilment reconciliation. | Layers: official, industry, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-006: QR and fake cashback deception](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/qr-cashback-deception/): UPI-006 — social engineering via deceptive QR codes, cashback claims, and tampered payment links. | Layers: official, industry, research, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-007: Fake support and grievance impersonation](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/fake-support-impersonation/): UPI-007 — search-result, social-media, and bogus call-centre impersonation around refunds and failed payments. | Layers: official, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-008: Untrusted app and remote-access risk](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/untrusted-app-access/): UPI-008 — sideloaded APKs, screen mirroring, remote-access coercion, and mobile RASP controls. | Layers: official, atlas | Stage: Draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23 | Source blocker: NPCI/2025-26/IS/003 is corroborated by a member-bank mirror. The issuer original remains unverified.
- [UPI-009: Authentication and payment authorization](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/authentication-context/): UPI-009 — multi-factor authentication, dynamic factors, exemptions, and issuer responsibility. | Layers: official, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-010: Transaction velocity and EFRM monitoring](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/transaction-velocity/): UPI-010 — regulatory Enterprise Fraud Risk Management (EFRM) architecture, alert parameterization, staff calibration, and feedback loops. | Layers: official, industry, research, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-011: Repeated failed authentication attempts](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/failed-authentication/): UPI-011 — detecting credential stuffing, wrong-PIN probing, lockouts, and customer alerts. | Layers: official, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-012: Merchant onboarding and classification](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/merchant-onboarding/): UPI-012 — Payment Aggregator KYC/CDD, MCC classification, acquiring bank oversight, and transaction laundering risks. | Layers: official, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-013: UPI dispute and complaint routing](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/dispute-routing/): UPI-013 — RBI Online Dispute Resolution (ODR), PA chargeback/dispute flows, and separating failed vs. fraudulent incidents. | Layers: official, industry, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-014: Settlement and reconciliation exceptions](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/settlement-exceptions/): UPI-014 — interbank settlement-file reconciliation, failed-transaction TATs, and scheme exception handling. | Layers: official, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-015: Unauthorized and fraudulent transaction customer protection](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/customer-liability/): UPI-015 — customer liability allocation, burden of proof, 2026–2027 commercial-bank amendments vs. payments-bank baseline. | Layers: official, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23
- [UPI-016: Digital payment fraud safeguards under discussion](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/risk-discussion/): UPI-016 — RBI's April 2026 Discussion Paper on lagged credit, trusted-person verification, KYC credit checks, and kill switches. | Layers: official, atlas | Stage: Source-checked draft | Last source check: 2026-11-23

## Documentation & Policies
- [Methodology](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/methodology/): Methodology
- [Evidence and attribution policy](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/evidence-policy/): How the Atlas puts reference facts first and separates Regulatory, Industry practice, Community insight, Research & academic, and Atlas guidance layers.
- [Contribute](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/contribute/): Contribute
- [Licensing and reuse](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/licensing/): What can be reused and what remains the property of its original publisher.
- [UPI Risk-Stack Playbook](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/risk-stack-playbook/): End-to-end engineering guidance across prevention, detection, monitoring, investigation, reconciliation, disputes, customer impact and feedback loops.
- [Operator Insights & Evidence](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/operator-insights/): Company-reported payment engineering docs (Industry practice) alongside empirical Research & academic studies.
- [UPI Risk Glossary](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/glossary/): Core terms, participant roles, regulatory concepts, and operational distinctions across India's UPI ecosystem.
- [Verified Primary Sources Register](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/sources/): Verified RBI regulatory texts, NPCI circular status, and research references for UPI risk controls.
- [Coverage & Review Status](https://eyeinthesky6.github.io/india-fintech-risk-atlas/upi/coverage/): What the UPI compendium includes, which records are source-checked, and what release blockers remain.
